questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 16 cm and a height of 6 cm. What is its area?

block.label: Quick Recall
block.sub: Four options, one answer — keep it fast

questions.why: Area of a triangle is ½ × base × height, so ½ × 16 × 6 = 48 cm². Slow down and halve before writing the answer.

questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 18 cm and a height of 7 cm. Slow down and work it through: what is its area?

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: In a sealed container, what happens to the total mass during a chemical reaction?
questions.why: In a closed system, mass is conserved — atoms are rearranged into new products but none are created or destroyed.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What is it called when bubbles appear, showing a gas has been made in a reaction?
